quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #8
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what traffic laws they must follow. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: Which statement is true about work zones?

options.text: Fines for violations in work zones are the same as fines under normal traffic conditions.
You must slow down in work zones.
Slow down only if you see workers present.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must slow down in work zones.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be ready to stop for road equipment. Driving carefully through work zones keeps everyone safe — drivers, pedestrians, cyclists, and workers.

questions.question: You have a minor crash at an intersection. No one is hurt and damage is minimal. What should you do?

options.text: Leave your vehicle in the traffic lane until police arrive.
Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane, if possible.
Do not move your vehicle for any reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane, if possible.
questions.explanation: After a crash with no injuries, move your vehicle out of the traffic lane if you can do so safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The roadway ends ahead.
The road splits. You must turn either right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is splitting and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: When you pull into traffic from a parked spot, you should:

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of traffic.
Wait for the first two vehicles to pass, then enter the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into city or highway traffic, wait for a gap that is large enough for your vehicle to reach the same speed as other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road widens ahead.
One lane is ending. Merge to the left.
Highway entrance ramp ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending. Merge to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a lane is ending and traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: Driving on the interstate requires you to:

options.text: Be able to safely drive at higher speeds.
Stay alert at all times.
Both A and B.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both A and B.
questions.explanation: Safe interstate driving means you must stay alert and be able to drive at high speeds safely.

questions.question: "No zones" around trucks are areas where cars:

options.text: Are hidden in the truck's blind spots or are so close they prevent the truck driver from stopping and turning safely.
Have plenty of space behind the truck.
Are several car lengths away from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are hidden in the truck's blind spots or are so close they prevent the truck driver from stopping and turning safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are areas around trucks or buses where cars disappear from view due to blind spots. They are also areas where cars are too close to the truck, preventing the driver from stopping or turning safely. Being in a "no zone" greatly increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves or narrows ahead.
No right turn.
No passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves or narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a change in direction or a narrowing of the road. You may see these signs on sharp curves or approaching narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road ahead.
Do not enter.
Pedestrian crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: Which of these substances can affect driving ability?

options.text: Tranquilizers, marijuana, and sedatives.
Cough syrups and cold tablets with codeine or antihistamines.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Many drugs can impair driving. These include tranquilizers, sedatives, cough syrups, cold tablets, allergy medications, and illegal drugs. Some of these contain alcohol, codeine, or antihistamines.

questions.question: When driving near a large commercial vehicle, you should:

options.text: Follow it closely to reduce wind drag on your vehicle.
Avoid driving next to it for long periods of time.
Drive on its right side when on curves and hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid driving next to it for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Large commercial vehicles have large blind spots on each side. Do not stay next to them for long periods of time.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No U-turn.
No turning.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: When passing a row of parked vehicles, you should:

options.text: Be ready for a person or vehicle to suddenly enter your lane.
Expect all drivers and pedestrians to respect your right-of-way.
Drive close to the parked vehicles to leave room for moving traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for a person or vehicle to suddenly enter your lane.
questions.explanation: Keep space between your vehicle and parked vehicles. People may step out of parked cars without looking. Drivers may start moving before they see you.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop sign ahead.
Side road.
Railroad warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver does not dim their headlights, you should:

options.text: Look toward the center of the roadway.
Look toward the right side of the road.
Look straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver fails to dim their lights, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course. Do not respond by keeping your bright lights on.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road.
Loose gravel.
Slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Merging traffic.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to an upcoming steep hill. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid collisions and brake problems.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a single broken white line:

options.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You may cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: Georgia's Implied Consent Law means:

options.text: You must sign a statement that you will not drive after drinking more than three drinks.
You agree to be tested for alcohol in your blood if arrested for drunk or impaired driving.
You consent to a blood sample if an officer stops you for reckless driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: You agree to be tested for alcohol in your blood if arrested for drunk or impaired driving.
questions.explanation: Georgia's Implied Consent Law requires you to take a chemical test of your blood, breath, urine, or other bodily substances if a police officer asks. This test checks if you are under the influence of alcohol or drugs. If you refuse, your driver license will be suspended.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and keep your speed the same.
Speed up to leave the area quickly.
Slow down and pass carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and pass carefully.
questions.explanation: Watch for pedestrians who may cross in front of you. If you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this orange triangle symbol mean?

options.text: Dangerous intersections.
Slow-moving vehicles.
Yield signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicles.
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like an orange triangle. At night it appears as a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: When driving at night on a dark street, what should you do?

options.text: Drive slowly enough to stop within the area lit by your headlights.
Use high beam headlights to see vehicles ahead better.
Keep dashboard lights bright so other drivers can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly enough to stop within the area lit by your headlights.
questions.explanation: Drive slower at night than during the day because you cannot see as far ahead. Make sure you can stop your vehicle within the distance your headlights illuminate.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs tell you that you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. When you see these signs, be alert and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead.
The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: A driver license is a:

options.text: Requirement.
Privilege.
Right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Privilege.
questions.explanation: Driving is a privilege, not a right. All drivers must help keep roads safe. If you misuse this privilege, it can be taken away.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:

options.text: Slow down.
Stop.
Turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians with the right-of-way pass, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an upcoming corner. You must yield to:

options.text: Other vehicles also turning left.
All approaching vehicles.
Pedestrians on the sidewalk waiting for a "Walk" signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: All approaching vehicles.
questions.explanation: When making a left turn, yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles that have a green light heading toward you.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: While driving a motor vehicle on a highway, it is:

options.text: Illegal to drink alcohol or have open alcohol containers.
Legal to drink alcohol if you are not the driver.
Legal to drink alcohol while driving if you are not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Illegal to drink alcohol or have open alcohol containers.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while under the influence of alcohol. Drivers and passengers cannot have open alcohol containers in a vehicle that is running.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from the left.
Passing is allowed from the right.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. They mean no one can pass from either direction.

questions.question: Your reaction time slows down after:

options.text: Drinking alcohol.
Sleeping.
Working hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drinking alcohol.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reflexes and reaction time. It reduces your ability to see clearly and makes you less alert. As you drink more, your judgment gets worse and your driving skills decrease. You will have trouble judging distances, speeds, and how other vehicles are moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop sign ahead.
Railroad crossing ahead.
Construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: When entering the interstate on a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, you should:

options.text: Enter the far-right traffic lane right away and speed up to match traffic flow.
Use the shoulder of the road to speed up to match traffic.
Speed up only after you find a gap in traffic, then enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up only after you find a gap in traffic, then enter.
questions.explanation: On a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, wait for a gap in traffic before entering. Speed up only after you have found a safe gap.

questions.question: What does a yellow left turn arrow mean?

options.text: Get ready to yield to oncoming traffic.
The protected left turn is ending.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: A yellow left turn arrow means the protected turn is ending. You must get ready to yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: How should you make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the centerline before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach the corner in the right lane, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, signal to warn other drivers. Slow down and move to the lane closest to the right curb. Stay as close as possible to the right edge of the road.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.

options.text: Stop
Wrong way
Yield

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield
questions.explanation: Yield signs are downward-facing triangles. When you see this sign, slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
Always stop.
Divided highway ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
No U-turns.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. It means you cannot turn right where this sign is posted.
